title: Great experience
text: I had a great experience on the Run tour. Monica was very informative and went out to pace that was comfortable for me. She was very knowledgable and showed me all the sites before it got too busy. I thoroughly enjoyed this and we recommend it.
author: Joan_H

title: My guide was Rohan. He...
text: My guide was Rohan. He was very knowledgeable, great company for the run and a lot of fun. I was fortunate to be the only attendee which meant Rohan focused on my needs. I’d been travelling with my 2 year old and it was my first time in Barcelona. I used the running tour as a way of seeing sights I’d missed while my wife and daughter had a lie in. I wasn’t disappointed as I was able to see so many sights I’d missed and also get a different perspective of the city seeing it before most people woke up. The price was very reasonable. I’d highly recommend the running tour to anyone visiting Barcel
author: Matthew_C

title: A great way to see the city
text: Our guide, Rohan, was very warm and welcoming and had great information to share. He led us to some historical sites as well as the architectural highlights of the city. We took the 7:30 am tour and it was cool and calm-before everyone else was even awake.
author: Teresa_A

title: Can’t Miss!
text: The tour was so fun! Ended up being the only person on the tour so we could run at a nice conversational pace. Audrey is so knowledgeable and friendly! Highly recommend and got to see so many places before the crowds!
author: Fallon_R

title: Great way to see the city Day 1
text: If you are even a casual runner, this is a great way to see the city before the crowds take over the streets. The group was just 3 runners + the guide which made for a perfect size to set a pace and be able to enjoy the commentary and snap a few photos.
author: Freedom49498545496

title: Great first morning in Barcelona
text: Andra was an excellent guide and gave us a great overview of Barcelona, along with Spanish history. It was also nice to see many areas of Barcelona early, when weather was cooler and without crowds.
author: Kristen_M

title: Best use of time (and money)
text: This running tour was excellent. It is the best way to see the city. My tour guide was also very knowledgeable and made the run/tour enjoyable. I'm a slow runner and the guide adjusted to my pace. The tour was customized to my preference - i wanted more sightseeing and shorter runs stints. Overall great experience.
author: Chinasa_E

title: Thankful for the experience!
text: I booked this for my daughters and they were so excited afterwards because they saw so many sights while enjoying running! Audrey was their tour guide and she was the BEST and made sure their experience was memorable. Forever grateful and would highly recommend to those that are wanting an overview of the city while being guided on a safe and fun run! Also, I contacted them before meeting up to make sure we were at the right location and they were super nice, patient and friendly. Can’t say enough good things! Thank you, Audrey and Viator!
author: Lindsay_B

title: Memorable and super informative
text: Exceeded all expectations. A smart thing to do, not only by start your day actively, but also to quickly familiarize yourself with the town with a local runner/guide.
author: Paul_S

title: Barcelona Highlights
text: I love to run to see everything Barcelona has to offer, and I heartily recommend this for first-timers. It's different in the morning, when you can find all the nice places without the crowd. Emy shared the place's history and was well-informed. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ service for me.
author: Fahad_A
